source: Verified research, GitHub Copilot entry: https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/reference/copilot-cli-reference/cli-hooks-reference, https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/reference/hooks-reference, https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/tutorials/copilot-cli-hooks, and the SDK index.js embedded in VS Code 1.139.0 (skeptic: hook_pre_tool corrected, hook_session_start and hook_stop confirmed).

selection.sniffNote: The verified research names no Copilot hook env var, so Copilot is picked by --agent copilot or CI_AGENT.
selection.bareNote: A camelCase payload (toolName, no hook_event_name) is not Claude-shaped, so with no flag the deny is exit 2, which Copilot documents as a deny even when stdout says allow.

deny.source: Copilot hook_payload_example: exact deny output from the tutorial, {permissionDecision: deny, permissionDecisionReason}.

context.source: Copilot hook_session_start (skeptic: confirmed): only additionalContext is consumed for sessionStart, as top-level JSON.

PreToolUse.source: Copilot hook_payload_example: the documented camelCase preToolUse test input, toolArgs as a JSON-encoded string, plus sessionId, timestamp (ms) and cwd

PostToolUse.source: Copilot hook_post_tool: postToolUse stdin toolName, toolArgs, toolResult {resultType, textResultForLlm}

UserPromptSubmit.source: Copilot hook_user_prompt: userPromptSubmitted stdin prompt (output dropped for command hooks)

SessionStart.source: Copilot hook_pre_tool: a PascalCase event selects the snake_case payload {hook_event_name, session_id, timestamp (ISO), cwd}; hook_session_start gives source. The snake SessionStart shape is extrapolated from the documented PascalCase PreToolUse example

SessionEnd.source: Copilot hook_pre_tool lists sessionEnd among the events; its input keys are not in the verified research

Stop.source: Copilot hook_stop (skeptic: confirmed): the SDK fires agentStop with {transcriptPath, stopReason: end_turn, stop_hook_active}
